memorii.detalii:

Data: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 20:23:52 +0000
Subiect: Bubble now lets you import your vibe-coded apps

Conținut:
Plus MCP upgrades and better Agent notifications — all new this month



 <https://bubble.io>


 <https://bubble.io>


 <https://forum.bubble.io/t/monthly-community-update-november-2026/402513>


 <https://forum.bubble.io/t/monthly-community-update-november-2026/402513>



Hi Bogdan,


 Last month we opened Bubble up to your own AI tools with the Bubble MCP and 
introduced a faster, more accurate Agent 2. This month, we’re building on that. 
You can now bring an app you built elsewhere into Bubble, the MCP works with 
more tools and sees more of your app, and the Agent keeps you posted while it 
works.

Read everything on the forum  
<https://forum.bubble.io/t/monthly-community-update-november-2026/402513>
Read on the forum  
<https://forum.bubble.io/t/monthly-community-update-november-2026/402513>

— Josh Haas & Emmanuel Straschnov, Bubble co-founders





  



November release highlights:



 <http://bubble.io/import>

Bring your vibe-coded app into Bubble 📩


If you’ve built an app on Lovable, Claude Code, Replit, or a similar tool, you 
can now bring it into Bubble. Upload a .zip or .html file using the import 
button when you log in, or import through the Bubble MCP (beta). Either way, 
the Agent turns your app into a working Bubble app and you can keep building it.

Import your app  <http://bubble.io/import>



 


 
<https://forum.bubble.io/t/bubble-mcp-is-now-in-claude-s-and-chatgpt-s-directories-and-cursor-works-too-plus-some-new-capability-improvements/402502>

Building with Claude and ChatGPT just got easier 🤖


 You can now build on Bubble using Claude or ChatGPT. To connect them, search 
for Bubble in either tool’s directory, sign in, and you’re set up. It’s still 
in beta, and beyond chatting and editing, it can take screenshots to check its 
UI, read your dev and live logs, and pull your app’s metrics, so you can ask 
things like “how is my app performing this week?”

Read more on the forum  
<https://forum.bubble.io/t/bubble-mcp-is-now-in-claude-s-and-chatgpt-s-directories-and-cursor-works-too-plus-some-new-capability-improvements/402502>



 


 <https://bubble.io/home/app>

Know when the Agent is done 🔔


 The Agent can now notify you when it needs your attention or finishes a task, 
so you can work on something else while it runs. Turn it on in your app’s 
editor underSettings > Notifications > AI Agent. The Agent’s also gotten 
clearer about what it changed, showing you a more readable summary after each 
request.

Update your settings  <https://bubble.io/home/app>

Watch the recap  <https://bubble.io/blog/october-2026-founder-ama/>
